sources.snippet: Training data & PII realesr-general-x4v3 was trained by the Real-ESRGAN authors on public super-resolution datasets (DIV2K / Flickr2K / OST and a synthetic high-order degradation pipeline). The model upscales image pixels only — no faces, identities, or other personal attributes are detected, recognized, or output.
